jobs.title: Software Engineer - Federal
jobs.description: It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. Join us to put AI to work for people. Job Summary The Software Engineer designs, builds, and ships features for the Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) suite of products, which helps organizations align work with business objectives, manage demand, resources, and projects, and accelerate product and service delivery. This role combines strong engineering execution with product judgment. The engineer works closely with product managers to understand customer problems, shape solutions, and deliver them end to end. The role also builds AI-native features and uses AI tools to accelerate design, development, testing, and delivery. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and deliver features for the Portfolio Management suite. Build AI-native features that use generative and agentic capabilities to improve planning workflows, insights, and user experience. Apply AI tools effectively across the development lifecycle, including code generation, test creation, debugging, documentation, and code review, while validating output for correctness, security, and maintainability. Partner with product managers to translate customer needs into well-scoped technical solutions and to weigh trade-offs between user value, complexity, and delivery timelines. Write clean, tested, and maintainable code with automation and participate in code reviews, design reviews, and release activities, and contribute to team engineering practices. Investigate and resolve production issues, including P1 escalations during US business hours, and drive root cause analysis and preventive fixes. Contribute to platform security, accessibility (WCAG), and quality improvements. Qualifications * This position is not eligible for employment-based sponsorship* U.S. citizen or Green card (lawful permanent resident) holder only. This requirement is due to federal contract eligibility. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience, or a Master's degree in a related field with 2–3 years of professional software engineering experience. Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. Demonstrated experience building applications full stack applications using modern UX frameworks, JavaScript/TypeScript and a server-side language (for example, Java or Python). Builder mindset: thinks like a product manager, designer, engineer, and tester at the same time, weighing user value, usability, technical design, and quality risk before committing to a solution. Demonstrated effective use of AI tools (such as coding assistants, LLM-based tools, or AI-enabled testing) to improve engineering productivity, and sound judgment about when to rely on AI output and when to verify it. Strong communication skills and the ability to work with product, QE, and platform partners. Familiarity with developing products that are accessibility compliant (WCAG). For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $125,700 - $160,300 , plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location. Work Personas We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here . To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service. Equal Opportunity Employer ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. Accommodations We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: The SPB Agent platform is the AI reasoning layer behind Amazon Ads — powering agentic experiences that autonomously guide millions of advertisers, sellers, and sales teams with personalized, data-backed intelligence across the Ads Console, Seller Central, and Next Gen Selling. You'll design and deliver generative AI systems that reason over campaign performance, make autonomous decisions on behalf of sellers, and deliver hyper-personalized advertising guidance at massive scale. Experiences powered by the platform include AI Campaign Overview (a dynamic widget that adapts its narrative in real time based on performance data), AI Companion for Selling Partners (a personalized assistant that provides guidance and executes actions on behalf of sellers), and AI for Sales Teams (an intelligent copilot grounded in each advertiser's objectives and guardrails). You'll work at the intersection of large language models, distributed systems, and advertising — collaborating with AI researchers and engineers to shape how businesses connect with customers through AI. What Makes This Role Stand Out - The AI is the product — you're not adding AI to an existing tool; you're building the reasoning platform that powers multiple agentic products across Amazon Ads - Ships to millions — advertisers, sellers, and sales teams worldwide interact with the experiences your platform powers - Frontier AI stack — LLMs, agent-based architectures, autonomous decision-making, real-time personalization at massive scale - Greenfield agentic architecture — designing how AI agents reason, act, and explain themselves in an advertising context Key job responsibilities - Design and develop the SPB Agent platform — a secure, reusable, low-latency architecture that integrates generative AI/ML technologies to deliver consistent, well-reasoned advertiser guidance across multiple products - Deliver features end to end across the agentic AI stack, from LLM integration and prompt engineering to distributed serving infrastructure and real-time personalization - Optimize operational costs at scale through efficient resource utilization, token consumption management, and memory footprint reduction - Collaborate with AI researchers, scientists, and cross-functional teams to integrate AI-driven solutions across the Ads Console, Seller Central, and sales tools - Build scalable systems that process millions of data points to deliver hyper-personalized advertising experiences with low latency - Develop new approaches to conversational AI and natural language interactions in advertising contexts, translating research into production-quality features - Mentor peers through design reviews and code reviews, contributing to engineering quality as the platform scales About the team The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Security Communications
jobs.description: AWS Security's Security Communications (SecComms) team builds and operates the platforms, tools, and systems that enable Amazon's security organization to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders at scale. We support security events, ongoing security programs, vulnerability communications, and strategic initiatives that span multiple Amazon business units and AWS services. Our engineering products are the connective tissue between security findings, remediation owners, and the people responsible for keeping Amazon and its customers safe. We are seeking a senior Software Development Engineer to lead the design, development, and operation of software systems that power security communications workflows, automation, and integrations at scale. This role is for a technical leader who brings engineering rigor to ambiguous problems where the business need is understood but the technology strategy is not yet defined, who owns outcomes across system boundaries, and who thrives working across organizational boundaries with security engineers, program managers, and communications professionals. You will own the architectural direction of the SecComms platform, lead projects staffed by multiple engineers, and act as a force multiplier for the team. Security Communications serves as the engineering and operations hub for AWS-related security messaging, stakeholder notification, and communications tooling across the organization. Our team is responsible for building scalable platforms that enable consistent, reliable, and timely communication during high-severity security events, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, and routine security program operations. We are a cross-functional team - engineers work shoulder-to-shoulder with communications professionals, security operations personnel, AWS service owners, and executives. Candidates should be comfortable leading discussions and building consensus in this environment across both technical and non-technical domains. Key job responsibilities Design & Delivery • Own the architecture and technical direction of major systems within the SecComms platform, leading delivery across the full lifecycle - product strategy, scoping, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance. • Work backwards from customer and stakeholder needs to define requirements, then define the technology strategy to meet them where none yet exists, translating ambiguity into well-designed, extensible software. • Solve complex problems with multiple risks and roadblocks using solutions that are as simple as possible, both directly and by directing the work of other engineers, and explain those problems to others in simple, concise terms. • Balance constraints across new feature development, technical debt, and operational reliability; identify one-way-door decisions and advocate for the right long-term solution rather than short-term workarounds. • Produce exemplary, well-tested, documented code that sets the standard others emulate and adheres to the Amazon Code Bar. Operational Excellence • Lead ongoing operational support for the team with appropriate alarms, telemetry, runbooks, and on-call response; effectively prioritize trade-offs between operational improvements and other work. • Drive resolution of the root causes of operational issues and address systemic issues that reduce support costs across the team's services. • Take the lead in identifying and solving architecture deficiencies and areas where software bottlenecks innovation, including in systems you depend on but do not own. • Ensure software failures are addressed with permanent fixes that prevent recurring incidents. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Partnership • Partner with security engineers, program managers, communications leads, and adjacent teams to understand the business and customer value of the team's software, and influence the roadmaps and technical decisions of teams you depend on but don't control. • Build consensus and make an inclusive space for differing views when integrations, dependencies, or shared priorities arise across organizational boundaries. • Make effective priority trade-offs between feature development and operational work, prioritizing long-term results - software quality, business requirements, customer experience, and maintainability - across your team's and related teams' products. • Communicate technical designs and decisions clearly in writing to both technical audiences and to non-technical stakeholders and leadership. Mentorship & Engineering Culture • Actively coach or mentor multiple engineers, on your team and beyond; serve as someone members of other teams seek out for expertise. • Drive adoption of engineering best practices across the team; train new team members on how the SecComms software is constructed, tested, operated, and secured, and how it fits into the broader Amazon Security architecture. • Own and maintain documentation of what the team's software does, how it is built, and how it connects to the bigger picture; keep it current as systems evolve. • Seek diverse perspectives and feedback early, and proactively identify and drive adoption of industry innovations including new tools, design patterns, and AWS capabilities to ensure the team's skills keep pace.
